frames.t: Same six meetings, but Ana has the news. Each gray line is a pair that meets at some point; watch which ones are lit and when.
Time 1: Ana and Ben meet, and Ben hears the news from Ana.
Time 2: Cleo and Dev meet. Neither knows the news yet, so nothing is passed on.
Time 3: Ben and Cleo meet, and Cleo hears the news from Ben.
Time 4: Dev and Eli meet. Neither knows the news yet, so nothing is passed on.
Time 5: Ana and Ben meet, but both already have the news, so nothing changes.
Time 6: Eli and Fay meet. Neither knows the news yet, so nothing is passed on. The news went from Ana to Ben to Cleo and stopped: Cleo's meeting with Dev was over before she heard.
Same six meetings, but Dev has the news. Each gray line is a pair that meets at some point; watch which ones are lit and when.
Time 1: Ana and Ben meet. Neither knows the news yet, so nothing is passed on.
Time 2: Cleo and Dev meet, and Cleo hears the news from Dev.
Time 3: Ben and Cleo meet, and Ben hears the news from Cleo.
Time 4: Dev and Eli meet, and Eli hears the news from Dev.
Time 5: Ana and Ben meet, and Ana hears the news from Ben.
Time 6: Eli and Fay meet, and Fay hears the news from Eli. Dev's news reached all 5 others, in the order of the meetings.
